name: ArkoAI
shortDescription: Renders a Rhino, Revit, or SketchUp view, or a screenshot. 20 free basic renders.
longDescription: ArkoAI renders the active view inside Rhino, Revit, or SketchUp. If you do not use a plugin, you upload a screenshot in the web app. The basic model includes 20 free renders. See their site for current pricing.
pricingNotes: The basic model includes 20 free renders. See their site for current pricing.
freeTierNotes: 20 free renders on the basic model.
bestFor: A model view you want rendered without leaving Rhino, Revit, or SketchUp
A screenshot of a model that should become a render
notIdealFor: A paper blueprint with no model screenshot
Virtual staging of a listing photo
strength: ArkoAI renders the active view in Rhino, Revit, or SketchUp, and the web app accepts a screenshot.
weakness: The public site lists 20 free basic renders and does not publish a dollar plan.
